previous_action: Following the installation of semi-permanent works inside the new holdings, Valerius increases attention given to the wounded from the expedition so it can resume as soon as possible. He hires professional builders, smiths, masons, lumber workers, and blacksmiths to live on his estate in return for residence and working their rent through labor for him.

continuity.campaign_development: Valerius has converted the new holding into a more durable forward base and established a resident skilled workforce of builders, masons, smiths, lumber workers, and blacksmiths. Wounded expedition men are receiving sustained care so the field force can recover. The lake-road site remains a future commercial possibility rather than an operating port.
